summary.headline: Astrological Definitions, Entries 283–305
summary.text: Catalog entries 283–305 of a Florentine astrological codex, covering configurations, rays, sign classifications, twelfth-parts, application and separation, subtractor and adder, station, solar beams, diurnal and nocturnal stars, ecliptic nodes, house rulers, leaping out, falling in, prorogation, enclosure, star houses, and joint rulership, with folio references 214v–216v.
